### Symptoms verified

### Symptoms dropped

### Source
scripts/gen-jobs.sh overwrites every file named in scripts/jobs.list from scripts/job.tmpl, and the template holds TZ=UTC. Each run of the generator undoes every edit made by hand.

### Single point
scripts/job.tmpl line 3.
